scope.note: Framework status is an audited shared-working-tree snapshot. Concurrent font-feature-settings and text-rendering implementation was intentionally not modified by this audit.

captureBaseline.configuredTest: tools/import-design/runtime-capture/test/capture-source-cdp.test.ts source-wide compatibility properties are observable before lowering
captureBaseline.gate: Existing source captures predate the expanded STYLE_PROPERTIES list and cannot prove any of these properties. Recapture every exercised source state before closing a property.

sourceOccurrences.surface: CodeBlockContainer inline React style paired with contentVisibility: auto

pipeline.paintOrLayout: absent; the legacy scripted bridge deliberately treats contain and contentVisibility as accepted no-op performance hints

properties.rationale: Palot uses this only as the fallback extent for content-visibility:auto code blocks. An eager native layout does not skip offscreen content, so applying the 200px fallback would be less faithful than omitting the browser optimization hint.
closureGate: Emit a named render-neutral exclusion receipt only when contain-intrinsic-size is paired with content-visibility and the native lane eagerly measures the real subtree.
Prove identical visible pixels, transcript scroll extent, and scroll-anchor behavior with long offscreen code blocks.
Fail closed if a future source uses contain-intrinsic-size as an observable sizing dependency rather than a skipped-content performance hint.

pipeline.typedLowering: present in observed-dom typography as fontFeatureSettings when value is not normal
pipeline.nativeIr: working-tree fields, parse, serialize, projection, and C++ codegen are present
pipeline.materialization: not complete at audit snapshot; generated setters have no proven end-to-end materializer/Label inheritance chain
pipeline.paintOrLayout: primitive exists: Canvas set_font_features and Skia shaping are tested; Label currently parses only the separate fontVariant keyword vocabulary, not arbitrary CSS feature-tag/value pairs

closureGate: Parse the CSS grammar into validated four-character OpenType tags plus integer values; unsupported syntax must diagnose, not silently disappear.
Apply inherited settings to every native text painter, including Label, TextButton, Markdown spans, TextEditor, measurement, ellipsis, and caret metrics.
Prove capture to typed IR to serialized IR to materializer to Skia shaping with ss01, ss03, rlig, and calt fixtures.
Run source/native screenshot and text-layout comparisons using the bundled Palot font; font substitution is a failure.

sourceOccurrences.surface: global, scrollbar-thin, and scrollbar-auto rest/hover/active states

pipeline.nativeIr: no scrollbar-color field; VisualSkin can already store scrollbarTrack and scrollbarThumb colors but the observed-DOM adapter does not project this property into those roles
pipeline.materialization: partial primitive only: ScrollView reads stateful scrollbar VisualSkin colors; imported repeated VirtualList currently hides indicators and generic overflow nodes are not converted into a source-styled ScrollView
pipeline.paintOrLayout: ScrollView paints track/thumb; VirtualList and VirtualGrid use theme colors instead of imported scrollbar state colors

closureGate: Lower the two CSS colors after custom-property resolution into explicit track/thumb state skins with rest, hover, and active precedence.
Route the skin through every imported scroll owner actually selected by lowering, including collection-backed VirtualList/VirtualGrid where used.
Preserve transparent rest state for scrollbar-auto and source colors for hover/active without inventing always-visible chrome.
Prove rest, hover, active, scrolling, and dragging screenshots plus hit behavior.

sourceOccurrences.surface: global, scrollbar-thin, scrollbar-auto, and scrollbar-none policies

pipeline.paintOrLayout: native primitives are fixed rather than source-driven: ScrollView animates toward 6px; VirtualList and VirtualGrid hardcode 6px width, 2px pad, and a 12px hit zone

closureGate: Introduce a typed auto/thin/none policy and keep visual width separate from a minimum accessible hit target.
Apply the policy consistently to ScrollView, VirtualList, and VirtualGrid selected by imported content.
Reserve or overlay scrollbar clearance according to observed source geometry; none must paint no bar and consume no gutter.
Prove content width, right-edge clearance, scrollbar pixels, wheel/drag behavior, and resize behavior at Palot breakpoints.

pipeline.capture: configured, fresh computed-style evidence absent; inline SVG outerHTML is captured separately
pipeline.nativeIr: partial faithful path: inline-svg canonicalization allowlists stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset and emits a faithful_svg asset
pipeline.materialization: faithful_svg assets materialize as DesignFrameView and resolve into Skia SVG DOM
pipeline.paintOrLayout: Skia SVG is expected to paint dash geometry, but the current inline-SVG tests do not assert dash preservation or compare dashed pixels; generic non-SVG CSS use is unsupported

closureGate: Add canonicalization and IR round-trip assertions for stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset.
Add Skia and Dawn screenshot tests for a static dashed path and for the Palot progress-ring circumference/offset geometry.
Capture and validate animation frames for spinner/progress motion where dash offset changes.
Classify non-inline-SVG computed-style use separately and fail with an explicit unsupported diagnostic until a generic vector paint path exists.

pipeline.typedLowering: present for optimizeSpeed, optimizeLegibility, and geometricPrecision
pipeline.nativeIr: working-tree field, parse, serialize, projection, and C++ codegen are present
pipeline.materialization: not complete at audit snapshot; no proven inherited native text-quality setting reaches all text widgets
pipeline.paintOrLayout: no explicit text-rendering policy is represented in Canvas/Skia; default shaping and antialiasing alone do not prove the authored keyword survived

closureGate: Define an explicit cross-platform text-quality contract for auto, optimizeSpeed, optimizeLegibility, and geometricPrecision instead of accepting a storage-only string.
Map optimizeLegibility to the high-quality shaping path used by Palot and apply it consistently to measurement and paint.
If two keywords are indistinguishable on a backend, emit a tested semantic-equivalence receipt rather than claiming separate visual behavior.
Prove source/native glyph raster and line-break comparisons at multiple scales with the bundled Palot font.

summary.blockingRule: No property leaves the backlog merely because it is cataloged, captured, serialized, or stored. Closure requires a fresh exercised source capture and either a tested native behavior chain or a tested render-neutral exclusion receipt.
